arabic_text: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمنِ الرَّحيمِ
transliteration: bismi allahi alrrahmani alrraheemi
english_text: O Allah, I beseech Thee with Thy Name;

arabic_text: اَلْحَمْدُ للهِ رَبِّ الْعالَمينَ
transliteration: al-ḥamdu lillāhi rabbi al-ʿālamīn
english_text: Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.

arabic_text: وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلى سَيِّدِنا مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ سَلَّمَ تَسْليماً
transliteration: wa ṣalla allāhu ʿalā sayyidinā muḥammadin nabiyyihi wa ālihi wa sallama taslīman
english_text: And blessings of Allah and peace be on our Chief Muhammad, His Prophet, and on his children.

arabic_text: اَللّـهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلى ما جَرى بِهِ قَضاؤكَ في اَوْلِيائِكَ الَّذينَ اسْتَخْلَصْتَهُمْ لِنَفْسِكَ وَ دينِكَ
transliteration: allāhumma laka al-ḥamd ʿalā mā jarra bihi qadā'uka fī awliyā'ika al-ladhīna istakhlash-tahum li-nafsika wa dīnik
english_text: O my Allah! (All) praise is for Thee for that which Thou decided upon and resolved in the matter of Thy friends, whom Thou purified for Thyself and Thy religion.

arabic_text: اِذِ اخْتَرْتَ لَهُمْ جَزيلَ ما عِنْدَكَ مِنَ النَّعيمِ الْمُقيمِ الَّذي لا زَوالَ لَهُ وَ لاَ اضْمِحْلالَ بَعْدَ اَنْ شَرَطْتَ عَلَيْهِمُ الزُّهْدَ في دَرَجاتِ هذِهِ الدُّنْيَا الدَّنِيَّةِ وَ زُخْرُفِها وَ زِبْرِجِها
transliteration: 'idh-i akhtar-ta lahum jazilan mā 'indaka mina al-na'īmi al-muqīm-i alladhi la zawala lahu wa la admiḥala baʿda an sharat ta ʿalayhimu al-zuhda fi daraajati hadhihi al-dunya al-dunyaa wa zukhrufiha wa zibrigihā
english_text: When wisdom and high rank from Thee, prostrated themselves in adoration before them (from the Bountiful Preserving Lord), for whom neither there was any decreased, nor dispersion thereafter, then Thou stipulated for them piety and righteousness. While they were in this mean and crooked world, free from its pomp, vanity and false enjoyments,

arabic_text: فَشَرَطُوا لَكَ ذلِكَ وَ عَلِمْتَ مِنْهُمُ الْوَفاءَ بِهِ فَقَبِلْتَهُمْ وَ قَرَّبْتَهُمْ وَ قَدَّمْتَ لَهُمُ الذِّكْرَ الْعَلِيَّ وَ الثَّناءَ الْجَلِىَّ وَ اَهْبَطْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ مَلائِكَتَكَ وَ كَرَّمْتَهُمْ بِوَحْيِكَ وَ رَفَدْتَهُمْ بِعِلْمِكَ
transliteration: fa sharatū laka dhālika wa ʿalimta minhum al-wafāʾa bihi faqabilthum wa qarrabtahum wa qaddamta lahumu aldhikra al'aliya wa alththanaa aljaliya wa ahbathta ʿalayhim malā'ikataka wa karramtahum biwahyika wa rafadta hum biʿilmika
english_text: Thy overreaching authority made known their identity; and equipped them with sincerity and perfection stood surety for them and communicated intimately with them, sent the news of their auspicious arrival in advance, and praised them clear terms for the benefit of one and all. Fell down on the ground in prostration Thy Angels before them, Thou chose them to reveal Thy Words, gave them Thy wisdom as a gift,

arabic_text: وَ جَعَلْتَهُمُ الذَّريعَةَ اِلَيْكَ وَ الْوَسيلَةَ اِلى رِضْوانِكَ
transliteration: wa jaʿaltahumu aldhariʿah ilaykawa alwasilata ila rizwanik
english_text: set them up as the (only) medium to reach Thee, the only means to the eternal land of peace and happiness.

arabic_text: فَبَعْضٌ اَسْكَنْتَهُ جَنَّتَكَ اِلى اَنْ اَخْرَجْتَهُ مِنْها
transliteration: fabaʿḍun askantahu jannataka ila an akhrajtahu minha
english_text: One dwelled in Paradise until Thou sent him on (as the first Prophet).

arabic_text: وَ بَعْضٌ حَمَلْتَهُ في فُلْكِكَ وَ نَجَّيْتَهُ وَ مَنْ آمَنَ مَعَهُ مِنَ الْهَلَكَةِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ
transliteration: wa baʿḍun ḥamaltahu fī fulkika wa najjaytahu wa man ʾāmana maʿahu min al-halakati bi-raḥmatika
english_text: One was made to cruise the "Ark", and had been rescued, and kept safe from destruction through Thy mercy.

arabic_text: وَ بَعْضٌ اتَّخَذْتَهُ لِنَفْسِكَ خَليلاً وَ سَأَلَكَ لِسانَ صِدْقٍ فِي الاْخِرينَ فَاَجَبْتَهُ وَ جَعَلْتَ ذلِكَ عَلِيّاً
transliteration: wa baʿḍun ittakhadhta-hu li-nafsika khaleelan wa saʾalaka lisana ṣidqin fīl-ākhirīna fa-ajabtahu wa-jaʿaltadhika ʿaliyyan
english_text: One was chosen and prepared for Thy Mission, as (Thy) Friend, (who) made a request to Thee for a good report (his) later generations, so Thou approved and complied with, exalted them and gave them authority.

arabic_text: وَ بَعْضٌ كَلَّمْتَهُ مِنْ شَجَـرَةٍ تَكْليماً وَ جَعَلْتَ لَهُ مِنْ اَخيهِ رِدْءاً وَ وَزيراً
transliteration: wa baʿḍun kallamtahu min shajaratin taklīman wa jaʿaltahu min akheehi rid'an wa wazeeran
english_text: One was spoken directly through the Tree, his brother was appointed his successor and helper.

arabic_text: وَ بَعْضٌ اَوْلَدْتَهُ مِنْ غَيْرِ اَبٍ وَ آتَيْتَهُ الْبَيِّناتِ وَ اَيَّدْتَهُ بِرُوحِ الْقُدُسِ
transliteration: wa ba`ḍun awladtahu min ghayri abin wa ataytahu al-bayyinat wa ayyadtahu bi-ruhi al-qudus
english_text: One was brought in without a father, was given clear proofs, and was supported with the Holy Spirit.

arabic_text: وَ كُلٌّ شَرَعْتَ لَهُ شَريعَةً وَ نَهَجْتَ لَهُ مِنْهاجاً ، وَ تَخَيَّرْتَ لَهُ اَوْصِياءَ مُسْتَحْفِظاً بَعْدَ مُسْتَحْفِظٍ مِنْ مُدَّةٍ اِلى مُدَّةٍ اِقامَةً لِدينِكَ ، وَ حُجَّةً عَلى عِبادِكَ
transliteration: wa kullun sharaʿta lahū sharīʿatan wa nahajta lahu minhajan, wa takhayyarta lahu awsiya'a mustaḥfiẓan baʿda mustaḥfiẓin min muddatin ila muddatin iqāmatan li-dinika, wa ḥujjatan ʿalā ʿibādika
english_text: For each Thou prescribed a Divine law, and set up a traced out path, each was appointed a guardian-executor, (and each) fulfilled the duty after being kept safe and protected, in the term of establishing Thy religion, a witness and argument over Thy servants (mankind),

arabic_text: وَ لِئَلّا يَزُولَ الْحَقُّ عَنْ مَقَرِّهِ وَ يَغْلِبَ الْباطِلُ عَلى اَهْلِهِ وَ لا يَقُولَ اَحَدٌ لَوْلا اَرْسَلْتَ اِلَيْنا رَسُولاً مُنْذِراً وَ اَقَمْتَ لَنا عَلَماً هادِياً فَنَتَّبِـعَ آياتِكَ مِنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ نَذِلَّ وَ نَخْزى
transliteration: wa li'alla yazuwal alhaqqu 'an maqarrihi wa yaghlib albatilu 'ala ahlihi wa lā yaqūla ʾaḥadun lawlā arsalta ʾilaynā rasūlan munẓirā wa aqamta lana 'ilman hadiyan fanattabiʿa āyātika min qabli an nadhilla wa nakhzā
english_text: Lest the truth staggered from its firm stand and foundation, and the falsehood conquered the hearts of the people, and might not say a single man: "If only Thou had sent a Messenger unto us as a Warner, to show us the path of wisdom and guidance, so that we might have followed Thy revelations before we were (thus) humbled and disgraced!"

arabic_text: اِلى اَنِ انْتَهَيْتَ بالأمْرِ اِلى حَبيبِكَ وَ نَجيبِكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
transliteration: 'ilá anita'hayta bil'amri 'ilá ḥabībika wa najībika muḥammadin ṣallá allāhu 'alayhi wa ālihi
english_text: Thou made plans to bring out the wonderful advent of Muhammad, (Send blessing on him and on his children).

arabic_text: فَكانَ كَمَا انْتَجَبْتَهُ سَيِّدَ مَنْ خَلَقْتَهُ وَ صَفْوَةَ مَنِ اصْطَفَيْتَهُ ، وَ اَفْضَلَ مَنِ اجْتَبَيْتَهُ وَ اَكْرَمَ مَنِ اعْتَمَدْتَهُ ، قَدَّمْتَهُ عَلى اَنْبِيائِكَ وَ بَعَثْتَهُ اِلَى الثَّقَلَيْنِ مِنْ عِبادِكَ
transliteration: fa kāna kamā intajabtahu sayyida man khalaqtahu wa ṣafwatama^ni ... ijtabaytahu wa akram min iʿtamadta-hu, qaddamta-hu ʿala anbiya-ika wa baʿathtahu ila al-thaqlayn min ʿibadika
english_text: So Thou just as chose him master of Whosoever Thou created, made him (whom Thou Selected), pure, clean and the best, exalted and praised him (whom Thou elected), surpassed in generosity and liberality while bestowing high-mindedness and beneficence upon him (whom Thou took in confidence and relied upon); made him leader-in-chief of (all) thy Prophets, and sent him to the troubled world of men and jinn, among Thy servants,

arabic_text: وَ اَوْطَأتَهُ مَشارِقَكَ وَ مَغارِبَكَ ، وَ سَخَّرْتَ لَهُ الْبُراقَ وَ عَرَجْتَ ( به ) بِرُوْحِهِ اِلى سَمائِكَ وَ اَوْدَعْتَهُ عِلْمَ ما كانَ وَما يَكُونُ اِلَى انْقِضاءِ خَلْقِكَ
transliteration: wa awta'tahu mashariqaka wa magharibaka, wa sakhkhartalahul-buraq wa ʿarajta (bihi) bi-rūḥihi ilá samāʾika wa awdaʿtahu ʿilmam mā kāna wa mā yakūnu ilā inqiḍāʾi khalqika
english_text: lowered and humbled before him the Easts and the Wests, under his total control was brought all affairs, exalted his soul in Thy heavens gave over to him the knowledge of what took place and what will happen, concerning facts and operation of creation.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ نَصَرْتَهُ بِالرُّعْبِ حَفَفْتَهُ بِجَبْرَئيلَ وَ ميكائيلَ وَ الْمُسَوِّمينَ مِنْ مَلائِكَتِكَ
transliteration: thumma nasartahu birruʿb ḥafaf̣tahu bijabrāʾīla wa mīkāʾīla wa almusawwimin min malāʾikatika
english_text: Then invested him with awe and majesty, Jibraeel, Meekaaeel, and distinguished Angels stood around;

arabic_text: وَ وَعَدْتَهُ اَنْ تُظْهِرَ دينَهُ عَلَى الدّينِ كُلِّهِ وَ لَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ
transliteration: wa waʿadtahu an tuzhiru deenahu ʿala al-dini kullihi wa law kariha al-mushrikoon
english_text: him at his beck and call, gave Thy word to him that Thou would make his religion prevail over all religions, however much the idolaters may be averse.

arabic_text: وَ ذلِكَ بَعْدَ اَنْ بَوَّأتَهُ مَبَوَّأَ صِدْقٍ مِنْ اَهْلِهِ وَ جَعَلْتَ لَهُ وَ لَهُمْ اَوَّلَ بَيْتٍ وُضِعَ لِلنّاسِ لَلَّذي بِبَكَّةَ مُبارَكاً وَ هُدىً لِلْعالَمينَ فيهِ آياتٌ بَيِّناتٌ مَقامُ اِبْراهيمَ وَ مَنْ دَخَلَهُ كانَ آمِناً
transliteration: wa dhalika baʿda an bawwatahu mabawwaʾa sidqin min ahlihi wa jaʿaltalahu walahu waawwala baytin wudhiaʿa linnas lilladhī bi-bakkah mubārakan wa hudan lil-ʿālamīn fīhi āyātun bayyinātun maqām ibrāhīm wa man dakhalahu kāna āminan
english_text: Thereafter acknowledged his atonement and provided good and perfection for his children, allotted for him and his children the first sanctuary appointed for mankind, at Becca (Mecca), a blessed place, a guidance to the people wherein are plain and clear signs; the place where Ibraahim stood up to pray, and whosoever enters it is safe.

arabic_text: وَ قُلْتَ : { اِنَّما يُريدُ اللهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمُ الرِّجْسَ اَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ وَ يُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهيراً } ثُمَّ جَعَلْتَ اَجْرَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَواتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ مَوَدَّتَهُمْ في كِتابِكَ
transliteration: wa qulta: "innama yureedullahu liyudhhibaa 'ankumu alrrijsa." ahla al-bayt wa yutahhirakum tathira thumma jaʿalt-a ajra muḥammadin ṣalawātuka ʿalayhi wa ālihi mawaddatahum fi kitābika
english_text: Thou said: "Allah’s wish is but to remove uncleanness far from you, O "People of the House", and purify you with a thorough purification." Thereupon Thou settled conclusively fee (recompense) of Muhammad (Thy blessings be on him and on his children) love for them, in Thy Holy Book.

arabic_text: فَقُلْتَ: { قُلْ لا اَسْاَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ اَجْراً اِلاَّ الْمَوَدَّةَ فِى الْقُرْبى } وَ قُلْتَ : { ما سَألْتُكُمْ مِنْ اَجْرٍ فَهُو َلَكُمْ } وَ قُلْتَ : { ما اَسْاَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ الّا مَنْ شاءَ اَنْ يَتَّخِذَ اِلى رَبِّهِ سَبيلاً } فَكانُوا هُمُ السَّبيلَ اِلَيْكَ وَ الْمَسْلَكَ اِلى رِضْوانِكَ
transliteration: faqultu: {qul lā as'alukum 'alayhi ajran illā al-mawaddata fī al-qurbá} wa qulta: {mā saʾaltukum min ajrin fahuwa lakum} wa qulta: "mā as'alkum 'alayhi min ajrin illā man shā'a an yattakhidha ilā rabbihī sabīlā." fakānū humu as-sabīla ilayka wa al-maslaka ilā riḍwānik
english_text: So Thou said: "Say (O Muhammad): I ask of you no fee (recompense) therefore, save love of (my) Kinsfolk." And Thou said: "Whatever recompense (return) I have asked for you, (it) is only for yourselves." And Thou said: "I ask of you no reward for this, save that, whoso will, chooses a way unto his Lord." Therefore they are the (only) means to (approach) Thee, the (only) medium to get Thy favours.

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا انْقَضَتْ اَيّامُهُ اَقامَ وَلِيَّهُ عَلِيَّ بْنَ اَبي طالِب صَلَواتُكَ عَلَيْهِما وَ آلِهِما هادِياً
transliteration: falammā inqaḍat ayyāmuhu aqāma waliyyahu ʿalīyya ibn abi ṭālib ṣalawātuka ʿal
english_text: So Thou certainly did not let his hard work go waste, and gave authority to his successor, Ali ibne Abi Taalib, (Thy blessings be on them both, and on this children), a guide.

arabic_text: اِذْ كانَ هُوَ الْمُنْذِرَ وَ لِكُلِّ قَوْمٍ هادٍ ، فَقالَ وَ الْمَلأُ اَمامَهُ :
transliteration: 'iḏ kāna huwa al-munḏira wa li-kulli qawmin hādin, faqāla wa al-mal'u 'amāmah.'
english_text: At the time when he was made a warner and a guide for every people, said he (the Holy Prophet), their Guide, in a public meeting overflowing with people;

arabic_text: مَنْ كُنْتُ مَوْلاهُ فَعَلِيٌّ مَوْلاهُ
transliteration: man kuntum mawlahu fa'alayyun mawlahu
english_text: "Of Whomsoever I am the Mawlaa (Lord, Master) Ali is his Mawlaa.

arabic_text: اَللّـهُمَّ والِ مَنْ والاهُ وَ عادِ مَنْ عاداهُ وَ انْصُرْ مَنْ نَصَرَهُ وَ اخْذُلْ مَنْ خَذَلَهُ وَ قالَ : مَنْ كُنْتُ اَنَا نَبِيَّهُ فَعَلِيٌّ اَميرُهُ وَ قالَ : اَنَا وَ عَلِيٌّ مِنْ شَجَرَةٍ واحِدَةٍ وَ سائِرُالنَّاسِ مِنْ شَجَرٍ شَتّى وَ اَحَلَّهُ مَحَلَّ هارُونَ مِنْ مُوسى
transliteration: "allāhumma wāli man wālahu, wa ʿādi man ʿādahu, wa anṣur man naṣarahu, wa akhḏul man kh wa qāla: man kuntu anā nabiyyahu faʿalīyun amīruhu wa qāla: anā wa ʿaliyyun min shajaratun wāḥidah wa sā'ir al-nās min shajarin shattā wa aḥallahū maḥallaha hārūna min mūsā
english_text: O Allah! be a friend of him who is a friend of him, be an enemy of him who is an enemy of him, help that man who helps him, forsake that man who forsakes him" said: "Of whosoever I am the Prophet Ali is his Chief." And said: "I and Ali are (one basic root of) a tree, and the rest of mankind are like diverse plants, he proclaims the position (relationship) of Haaroon to Moosaa."

arabic_text: فَقال لَهُ : اَنْتَ مِنّي بِمَنْزِلَةِ هارُونَ مِنْ مُوسى الّا اَنَّهُ لا نَبِيَّ بَعْدي وَ زَوَّجَهُ ابْنَتَهُ سَيِّدَةَ نِساءِ الْعالَمينَ
transliteration: faqāla lahu: anta minnī bimanzilati hārūna min mūsā illā annahu lā nabiyya baʿdī wa zawwajahu ibnatahu sayyidatu nisā'i al-'ālamīn
english_text: Therefore he told him: "I am to you as Moosaa was to Haaroon, but certainly there is no Prophet after me." His (Ali’s) life partner was his (Muhammad’s) daughter the chief of the women of the worlds.

arabic_text: وَ اَحَلَّ لَهُ مِنْ مَسْجِدِهِ ما حَلَّ لَهُ ، وَ سَدَّ الاَْبْوابَ اِلاّ بابَهُ
transliteration: wa ahlal lahu min masjidihi ma halla lahu, wa sadda al-abwaba illa babahu
english_text: Lawful was for him (Ali), in "the mosque", that which was permitted to him (Muhammad), all doors were closed, except his door.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ اَوْدَعَهُ عِلْمَهُ وَ حِكْمَتَهُ
transliteration: thumma awdaʿahu ʿilmahu wa ḥikmatahu
english_text: He (Muhammad) gave his knowledge and wisdom into his (Ali’s) keeping.

arabic_text: فَقالَ : اَنـَا مَدينَةُ الْعِلْمِ وَ عَلِىٌّ بابُها
transliteration: faqaala: ana madinatu al-ʿilmi wa ʿaliyyun babuhā
english_text: He said: "I am the city (center) of knowledge and Ali is its gate.
